rootCause: A successful DOM selection write stores the Rust selection's exact affinity, which native Selection cannot represent. The bridge previously deleted that record after its first matching read. A subsequent read of the unchanged interior caret derived after affinity instead of the original before affinity. Rust correctly treated the changed semantic selection as a state-only change and closed the typing merge group. End-of-text carets derive before affinity already and did not reproduce the failure.

reproduction.scenario: Type ABC at offset 0, 5, or the end of Write a first draft in the first numbered item. Undo once must restore the original document.

fix: Keep exact semantic affinity for a still-current, canonical render and exactly matching directional DOM endpoint signature. Consume only echoPending on the first read. Subsequent reads have origin dom but retain the exact semantic range. Nonmatching/absent/outside selection, failed reads, generation changes, explicit clear and disposal still invalidate the sidecar. No equality relaxation in Rust, skipped validation or wire change.
compatibility: Shared base/list bridge source behavior changes for repeated matching reads: origin remains dom after the first read, but exact semantic selection/affinity is retained instead of reconstructed. Current contracts updated. Shipping artifacts remain unchanged pending release qualification.
extendedCoverage: Start/middle/end list typing groups survive autosave/reload, one-step undo, saved redo and second reload
ArrowLeft then ArrowRight to the same offset separates a subsequent typing group; two undos/redos retain exact document history
Repeated caret/forward/backward reads retain exact affinity but suppress only one programmatic echo
Observed movement, explicit clear and disposal discard even a consumed affinity sidecar
Existing stale-generation, DOM-drift, alias, cross-host, directional selection, composition, clipboard and toolbar regressions remain green

baseSourceConfiguration.scope: Temporary Vite aliases point only browser root/advanced imports to current source; shipping Wasm/reference artifacts and existing editor.spec.ts remain unchanged. Full ordinary editor spec, original timeouts, one worker, zero retries.
baseSourceConfiguration.initialSetupFailure: Server initially resolved target/target/config because Playwright used the temporary config directory as cwd. Set explicit repository cwd; no tests had run and no product source was changed for this correction.

packedConsumers: All three list browser engines and existing base Node/strict TypeScript/Chromium smoke passed against the same private installed tarballs.
limitations: Native endpoint observations cannot distinguish an unchanged range from a move away and back that was never observed
Earlier intermittent browser faults/timeouts are not resolved by this fix
Delivery policy, size ceilings, large-list responsiveness and full release qualification remain open
